- tests/test_unblock_scan.py:701 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test still asserts the old loop string "for unblock_asset in scripts/unblock_scan.py scripts/unblock_ledger.py; do", but the workflow loop now also lists scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py.
  WHY: The assertion fails and CI goes red. Severity is BLOCKER in the source reviews, mapped here to the top level (critical).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19528-19534 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new comment in run_unblock_scan() contains the token UNBLOCK_JUDGE_ENABLED before the _issue_7251_dependency_wait_once call.
  WHY: tests/test_issue_7251_dependency_wait.py:357 asserts scan.index(once) < scan.index("UNBLOCK_JUDGE_ENABLED"), which now fails. Severity is BLOCKER in the source reviews, mapped here to critical.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:105-248 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py has no entry in the Scripts section of docs/INVENTORY.md and is not exempted in tests/inventory_exemptions.txt.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py fails with a missing-entry error and CI goes red. Severity is BLOCKER in the source reviews, mapped here to critical.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19477-19500 (also scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py:202-205) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: select() marks descendants closable because their parent is a candidate, but the shell runs the timeline check per item, so a held parent stays open while its descendants close.
  WHY: This breaks the documented rule that a parent closes in the same pass. tests/test_orphan_fixup_close.py:422-432 encodes this behavior. The reviewers' severity is MAJOR.
- scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py:234-239 (also scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19461-19465) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The per-tick cap is applied in select() before the per-item timeline check, so persistently refused fix-ups fill the cap every tick.
  WHY: Deeper closable fix-ups are never reached and the sweep stalls, with only held=N in the log. Confidence ranges from 3 to 5 across reviewers.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19465-19505 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A timeline-read failure only skips that candidate and later candidates still close.
  WHY: This contradicts the documented rule that any failed read closes nothing that tick, so a tick can end with partial closes. Anthropic rated it NIT, while the others rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19430 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: need_parents[:20] limits the parent lookup batch, and parents that are pull requests (parent_not_issue) are never resolved.
  WHY: Higher-numbered closed-issue parents stay parent_unknown and their fix-ups never close. Google rated it MAJOR, while Anthropic and Qwen rated it NIT.
- README.md:116 (also changelog.d/7543-close-orphan-unblock-fixup-chains.md) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The claim "A 17-deep chain clears in four ticks" is wrong because parents closed by the sweep fall inside the 60-minute grace (scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py:219-220), so each later batch waits about an hour.
  WHY: The documentation misstates the clearing time. Qwen rated it MAJOR, while the others rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19424,19455,19483 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The three scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py invocations use plain python3 instead of python3 -I -B while GH_TOKEN is in the environment.
  WHY: This is a hardening gap, because a shadowing module could be imported. No concrete path was verified.
- scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py:254-256 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The timeline checker treats a cross-reference with pull_request: null as not a PR, and scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1661-1665 sets that field to null for cross-repository PRs.
  WHY: A fix-up with an open cross-repository PR can be closed despite the rule to leave such fix-ups alone.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19477-19500 (race) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The timeline is checked in one call and the issue is closed in a separate call without rechecking.
  WHY: A person can close and reopen a fix-up between the two calls, so the sweep closes an already reopened issue.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19430-19456 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: A partial GraphQL response (data plus errors) is treated as a successful lookup, and failed aliases are dropped by jq. Anthropic raised this only as a hardening suggestion, noting that gh may exit non-zero and skip the whole sweep instead.
  WHY: The affected fix-ups silently stay parent_unknown every tick.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Only issues authored by the pipeline login with no label other than a block label are closed, and never a project issue, one with an open or unreadable linked pull request, or one that was reopened (README.md line 114). The whole chain goes in one pass, nearest the closed root first.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orphan_fixup_close.py and the close_orphan_fixup_chains_sweep loop
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_orphan_fixup_close.py covers each rule in isolation, and the test at lines 422-432 asserts the opposite behavior (#147 closes after #145 and #146 are skipped), so the one-pass chain rule is not enforced.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (three python3 scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py calls) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Plain python3 is used while the poller holds GH_TOKEN.
  WHY: Hardening only; no concrete import-shadowing path was verified.
- tests/test_unblock_scan.py:701 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The old loop-string assertion was not updated for the new workflow loop.
  WHY: The assertion fails and CI goes red.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, tests/test_issue_7251_dependency_wait.py:357 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new comment contains UNBLOCK_JUDGE_ENABLED before the _issue_7251_dependency_wait_once call.
  WHY: The ordering assertion fails.
- scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (select()/resolve() vs per-item timeline check) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Descendants close even when a mid-chain parent is refused.
  WHY: A closed fix-up is left under an open parent, which contradicts the documented rule. The harm is small because the held fix-up is retried next tick.
- scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py (chosen[: max(limit, 0)] in select()) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cap is applied before the timeline check.
  WHY: Persistently refused fix-ups fill the cap every tick and block deeper ones.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (ofc_timeline branch with continue) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed timeline read skips only that item, contradicting the docs that say a failed read closes nothing that tick.
  WHY: The docs and behavior disagree, though the skipped item is retried next tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (jq '.need_parents[:20][]?', parent_not_issue) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Pull request parents are never resolved and are requested again every tick.
  WHY: With 20 or more low-numbered PR parents, higher closed-issue parents stay parent_unknown.
- docs/INVENTORY.md (Scripts section, lines 332-333 list the neighbouring scripts) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: scripts/orphan_fixup_close.py has no inventory entry.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py fails.
- README.md and changelog.d/7543-close-orphan-unblock-fixup-chains.md (ORPHAN_FIXUP_CLOSE_MAX_PER_TICK) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "17-deep chain clears in four ticks" claim ignores the 60-minute grace.
  WHY: This is a documentation mismatch only.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the three python3 invocations
  PROBLEM: Plain python3 while the PAT is in the environment.
  WHY: Suggested fix is python3 -I -B (3 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the GraphQL parent lookup (gh_retry gh api graphql)
  PROBLEM: One unresolvable alias may make gh exit non-zero and skip the whole sweep every tick; gh's behavior was not verified.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to accept .data.repository even when .errors is present, or batch smaller (about 8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
